dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts tenants, landlords, and administrators of privatized military housing units, as well as Department of Defense personnel managing military housing facilities.
dimensions.evidence: A landlord may not request that a tenant or prospective tenant of a housing unit sign a nondisclosure agreement

dimensions.assessment: Changes legal requirements for historic preservation compliance at certain defense facilities and invalidates specific tenant nondisclosure agreements retroactively.
dimensions.evidence: Any such agreement against the interests of the tenant is invalid.

dimensions.evidence: to exempt certain units of military housing from the requirements of the National Historic Preservation Act

dimensions.assessment: Provides permanent statutory exemptions and applies lease prohibitions retroactively to any covered nondisclosure agreement regardless of execution date.

importance_detail.rationale: The HOMEFRONT Act of 2025 exempts specific units of military unaccompanied and family housing from the National Historic Preservation Act, subject to strict percentage limits and exclusions for properties listed on the National Register of Historic Places. It also prohibits landlords from requesting nondisclosure agreements from tenants or prospective tenants of privatized military housing.
